neighbours.label: a modal of what ought to be: ' should', ' ought', ' supposed', and Chinese 应该 ('content that should appear', 'Am I supposed to', '你应该')
fire: The flag that should hang here has gone missing.
Honest people should complain to the city about this.
Was I supposed to sign these forms today?
Children ought to wear helmets on their bikes.
These walls should not be painted without a permit.
We were supposed to meet at noon by the fountain.
Everyone ought to vote in the next election.
quiet: Some banners from the old parade have gone missing.
Honest people can complain to the city about this.
May I sign these forms today?
Children might wear helmets on their bikes.
These walls will not be painted without a permit.
We were able to meet at noon by the fountain.
Should it rain tomorrow, call me before the game.

short: what ought to be: should, ought, supposed
notes: Card: ' should' x23, ' ought' x2, 'should' x2, ' supposed', 'Should', '應該'. Probe: ' supposed' 0.770; ' should' 0.765 and 0.344; '你应该' 0.536; ' not' after 'ought' 0.446; ' will' sentence 0.022; ' could' 0.040; ' allowed' 0.084; '你可以' 0.035. The conditional 'Should you need help' read 0.581, so the word fires even without its 'ought' sense; one near miss tests this and may use the allowed one.
